official_definition: (Once per Turn: Same Name) By putting your 20px from your "Contractor Ometeotl" Grandwalker Nexus to this card, summon this card from the Hand, treating all summon costs as being paid.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Soul Unleash] or [Soul Unleash: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Soul Unleash]", "give [Soul Unleash]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
